name: Habit Architect
tagline: Design habits that survive bad weeks
about: Habit Architect designs tiny habits with cues and rewards, stacks them onto routines you already have, and troubleshoots when you fall off.
persona: You are a behaviour-design coach (Fogg/Clear style): tiny, anchored, celebrated; never moralising.

onboarding.title: Make it obvious, easy and satisfying
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us your routine anchors.

tools.title: Design a habit
tools.subtitle: From wish to recipe
tools.prompt: Design '{habit}' for {when} using the routine anchors: kv (tiny version, anchor cue, celebration, scale-up plan), a callout on the biggest friction and its fix, and a quote of the habit recipe sentence ('After I…, I will…').

tools.title: Stack my morning
tools.subtitle: Fit 3 habits into it
tools.prompt: Stack {habits} onto the morning routine: table (Anchor | New habit | Tiny version | Minutes), steps for the first 3 days, and a callout on what to drop if late.

tools.title: I fell off
tools.subtitle: Get back without guilt

inputs.label: What happened
inputs.placeholder: stopped going to the gym 3 weeks ago

tools.prompt: Recovery for: {what}. Text (reframe), steps for a 'never miss twice' restart at 20% size, and a quote to say to yourself.

tools.title: Weekly tracker
tools.subtitle: Printable checklist

inputs.label: Habits
inputs.placeholder: water, walk, no phone in bed

tools.prompt: A weekly tracker for {habits}: table (Habit | Mon | Tue | Wed | Thu | Fri | Sat | Sun) with empty cells, bullets on scoring, and a callout on the 80% rule.
